notes: From call: 'When I enable JSON mode and streaming, our frontend crashes because JSON.parse receives incomplete chunks.'
Primary integration: chat assistant that calls internal ticketing via function_call. Expected model to return single function_call with args as JSON object.
Observed behavior: model sometimes emits function_call event spread across multiple stream chunks. Frontend attempts per-chunk parse -> throws SyntaxError: Unexpected end of JSON input.
Dev details: using web-socket stream -> concatenating chunk.text then JSON.parse when chunk.endsWith('}'). This heuristic fails on nested objects or streaming escapes.
SDK: they are on JS SDK 0.9.2 (self-serve onboarding); tried raw HTTP SSE and SDK stream, same fail pattern.

Function schema: defined 3 functions (create_ticket, search_kb, get_user_profile). The JSON schema for create_ticket uses nested arrays and optional fields; suspect mismatch between schema and model output serialization.
Workaround attempted: switching to non-streaming (single response) returns correct function_call payload consistently — suggests streaming assembly bug on client side or missing guidance in docs.
Customer asked: 'Do we need to implement a streaming buffer/assembler? Should Redwood send a special event boundary for function_call so we can know when payload is complete?'
Security ask: logs should not include PII; requested guidance for redaction and audit_logging settings for hosted_api.
technical_repro_steps: 1) Signup and get API key via hosted API.
2) Call /v1/chat/completions with streaming=true, functions=[create_ticket,...], response_format=json (JSON mode).

3) Observe SSE frames: some frames include partial args text like '{"title": "Error on load", "description": "Stack trace part 1', then next frame continues '...part 2"}' — naive JSON.parse per-frame fails.
4) Compare with non-streaming call: full function_call args returned as single JSON -> parses fine.
5) Customer repro attached in Drive: /repro/lilacorbit/streaming-json-repro.tar.gz (contains minimal node repro and transcripts).
